Per-tab split-pane container — IS the TAB tree in the model.

detaileddescription.para: Inherits jam::Model::Component (IDtype::tab) so it owns a TAB ValueTree. Sets Name and componentID directly in the constructor body. Owns PaneManager (binary tree), PaneView pool, resizer bar pool, and Attachments for each PaneView child. PaneManager::layout() positions PaneViews and reconciles resizer bars on resized().
